_comment: send_code repair hints. Single source for the add-in (embedded resource) and offline evaluation. Each rule matches ONE diagnostic: 'code' is the C# compiler id (CS####) or 'runtime'; 'pattern' is a .NET/Python-compatible regex over the diagnostic message (runtime: 'ExceptionType: message'). First match wins, so specific rules come before generic ones. API names verified against the Inventor 2027 interop.

rules.pattern: '_?Document' does not contain a definition for 'ComponentDefinition'
rules.hint: Document has no ComponentDefinition. Cast first: ((PartDocument)doc).ComponentDefinition or ((AssemblyDocument)doc).ComponentDefinition (check doc.DocumentType).

rules.pattern: 'ComponentDefinition' does not contain a definition
rules.hint: occ.Definition is the generic ComponentDefinition. Cast it: (PartComponentDefinition)occ.Definition or (AssemblyComponentDefinition)occ.Definition.

rules.pattern: '(Material)?Asset' does not contain a definition for 'CopyToDocument'
rules.hint: Use asset.CopyTo(doc) (optional 2nd arg ReplaceExisting) — it returns the document-local Asset.

rules.pattern: 'SurfaceBody' does not contain a definition for 'Copy'
rules.hint: Copy a body with app.TransientBRep.Copy(body).

rules.pattern: 'ComponentOccurrence' does not contain a definition for 'DefinitionDocument'
rules.hint: Use occ.Definition.Document (cast to PartDocument/AssemblyDocument) or occ.ReferencedDocumentDescriptor.ReferencedDocument.

rules.pattern: 'LineSegment' does not contain a definition for 'StopPoint'
rules.hint: LineSegment exposes StartPoint / EndPoint (StopPoint is the SketchLine/Edge naming).

rules.pattern: 'Face' does not contain a definition for 'Area
rules.hint: Face area is face.Evaluator.Area (cm²; ×100 for mm²).

rules.pattern: 'Edge' does not contain a definition for 'Vertices'
rules.hint: An Edge has StartVertex / StopVertex (and Evaluator for its geometry).

rules.pattern: 'SurfaceEvaluator' does not contain a definition for 'GetParam
rules.hint: SurfaceEvaluator has ParamRangeRect (Box2d) and GetParamAtPoint(ref …) — there is no GetParamRange / GetParamPointOf….

rules.pattern: 'Sketch' does not contain a definition for '(ModelToSketchSpace|SketchToModelSpace)'
rules.hint: Cast to PlanarSketch: ((PlanarSketch)sk).ModelToSketchSpace(point) / SketchToModelSpace(point2d).

rules.pattern: 'ExtrudeFeature' does not contain a definition for 'Extent(One|Two)'|'ExtrudeDefinition' does not contain a definition for 'Distance'
rules.hint: Read the extent via ExtrudeFeature.Extent (cast to DistanceExtent: ((DistanceExtent)f.Extent).Distance is a Parameter) or f.Definition.Extent.

rules.pattern: 'PartFeature' does not contain a definition for 'Definition'
rules.hint: PartFeature is the generic base; cast to the concrete type first (e.g. (ExtrudeFeature)f) — check f.Type.

rules.pattern: 'AssemblyDocument' does not contain a definition for 'RepresentationsManager'
rules.hint: Use asm.ComponentDefinition.RepresentationsManager (design views: .DesignViewRepresentations), or the typed inventor_set_view_state.

rules.pattern: '_?Document' does not contain a definition for 'ObjectVisibility'
rules.hint: ObjectVisibility lives on PartDocument/AssemblyDocument — cast first, or use inventor_set_view_state(object_visibility={…}).

rules.pattern: 'View' does not contain a definition for 'ColorScheme'
rules.hint: The color scheme is application-wide: app.ActiveColorScheme / app.ColorSchemes.

rules.pattern: 'ComponentOccurrence' does not contain a definition for 'HealthStatus'
rules.hint: Occurrences have no HealthStatus; check constraints (inventor_list_constraints) or the part's features (inventor_list_features with document=…).

rules.pattern: 'object' does not contain a definition for '(?<member>\w+)'
rules.hint: The receiver is typed object — COM collections and late-bound properties come back as object (e.g. foreach (var d in app.Documents), occ.Definition.Document, param.Value). Declare the loop/element type or cast: foreach (Document d in app.Documents), (PartDocument)occ.Definition.Document, (double)p.Value.

rules.pattern: operands of type 'object' and
rules.hint: An operand is typed object (typically Parameter.Value or a COM collection item). Cast it: (double)p.Value * 10.

rules.pattern: operands of type 'Matrix' and 'Matrix'
rules.hint: Inventor Matrix has no operators. Use m.PostMultiplyBy(other) / m.PreMultiplyBy(other) (mutates m; copy first with m.Copy() if needed).

rules.pattern: No overload for method 'ToString' takes 1 arguments
rules.hint: The value is typed object, so ToString(format) is unavailable. Cast first: ((double)x).ToString("F2") or $"{(double)x:F2}".

rules.pattern: No overload for method 'GetMinimumDistance'
rules.hint: MeasureTools.GetMinimumDistance(entityOne, entityTwo) — the remaining 3 args are optional (InferredTypeEnum, InferredTypeEnum, ref object context). Or call inventor_measure_min_distance.

rules.pattern: No overload for method 'SaveAsBitmap'
rules.hint: View/Camera SaveAsBitmap(fileName, width, height[, topColor, bottomColor]). Prefer inventor_capture_view, which also handles camera/orientation.

rules.pattern: Argument 1: cannot convert from 'string' to 'int'
rules.hint: Inventor collections are indexed by 1-based int. Look up by name with the ItemByName indexed property — brackets, not parentheses: occs.ItemByName["Part:1"], or loop and compare .Name. PropertySets/Property accept a string via Item["Design Tracking Properties"].

rules.pattern: cannot convert from 'Inventor\.(Part|Assembly|Drawing|Presentation)Document' to 'Inventor\._?Document'
rules.hint: PartDocument/AssemblyDocument are separate COM interfaces, not subclasses of Document. Convert via object: (Document)(object)partDoc or (_Document)(object)partDoc.

rules.pattern: cannot convert from 'Inventor\.UnitVector' to 'Inventor\.Vector'
rules.hint: Use uv.AsVector() (and v.AsUnitVector() the other way round).

rules.pattern: cannot convert from 'Inventor\.Vector' to 'Inventor\.UnitVector'
rules.hint: Use v.AsUnitVector() (or app.TransientGeometry.CreateUnitVector(x, y, z)).

rules.pattern: cannot convert from 'int' to 'byte'
rules.hint: TransientObjects.CreateColor takes bytes: CreateColor((byte)r, (byte)g, (byte)b[, opacity]).

rules.pattern: cannot convert from 'Inventor\.\w+' to 'Inventor\.ObjectCollection'
rules.hint: Wrap items in an ObjectCollection: var oc = app.TransientObjects.CreateObjectCollection(); oc.Add(item);

rules.pattern: cannot convert from 'Inventor\.Sketch(Point|Line|Arc|Circle)' to 'Inventor\.SketchEntity'
rules.hint: Sketch entity interfaces do not inherit SketchEntity in interop. Convert via object: (SketchEntity)(object)line.

rules.pattern: cannot convert from 'ref [\w.]+' to 'ref double\[\]'
rules.hint: Evaluator methods fill double arrays: double[] pts = new double[0]; evaluator.GetXxx(ref pts, ...); then read pts[0..2].

rules.pattern: cannot convert from 'Inventor\.(?<from>\w+)' to 'Inventor\.(?<to>\w+)'
rules.hint: Interop interfaces rarely convert implicitly. Cast via object: (TargetType)(object)value, or pick the right property (e.g. a Face vs its SurfaceBody).

rules.pattern: may not be passed with the 'out' keyword
rules.hint: Inventor interop uses ref (not out) for array/outputs: double[] a = new double[0]; call(ref a).

rules.pattern: must be passed with the 'ref' keyword
rules.hint: Pass a pre-initialised variable with ref: double[] a = new double[0]; call(ref a).

rules.pattern: Indexed property '(?<prop>[\w.]+)' has non-optional arguments
rules.hint: This is an indexed property: supply its argument in brackets, e.g. body.Volume[0.0001] (tolerance) or call get_Volume(0.0001).

rules.pattern: Non-invocable member '.+' cannot be used like a method
rules.hint: Indexed properties use brackets, not parentheses: occs.ItemByName["Part:1"], body.Volume[0.0001].

rules.pattern: try directly calling accessor method
rules.hint: C# cannot use this COM property syntax. Call the accessor directly: get_X(...) / set_X(value), e.g. param.get_Units().

rules.pattern: 'HealthStatusEnum' does not contain a definition
rules.hint: HealthStatusEnum members end in 'Health': kUpToDateHealth, kOutOfDateHealth, kInErrorHealth, kSuppressedHealth, kDriverLostHealth, kUnknownHealth.

rules.pattern: Cannot implicitly convert type '(?<from>[\w.]+)' to '(?<to>[\w.]+)'\. An explicit conversion exists
rules.hint: Add an explicit cast: (TargetType)value — e.g. (Asset)materialAsset, (MaterialAsset)asset.

rules.pattern: Cannot assign void to an implicitly-typed variable
rules.hint: That method returns void (it mutates in place, e.g. Matrix.PostMultiplyBy). Call it as a statement and keep using the original object.

rules.pattern: Cannot assign <null> to an implicitly-typed variable
rules.hint: var needs a type: write e.g. PartDocument? doc = null;

rules.pattern: A local or parameter named '(?<name>\w+)' cannot be declared in this scope
rules.hint: In a script, top-level variables are visible inside every function and lambda — rename the inner variable.

rules.pattern: Only assignment, call, increment, decrement
rules.hint: To return a value from the script, make it the LAST line without a semicolon (e.g. result) or use `return new { ... };`.

rules.pattern: 'ProjectTypeEnum' does not exist
rules.hint: Use MultiUserModeEnum / DesignProject.ProjectType from the Inventor namespace; project switching is usually better done by the user in Inventor.

rules.pattern: InvalidCastException: Unable to cast COM object of type 'Inventor\._DocumentClass' to interface type 'Inventor\.(?<to>\w+)'
rules.hint: The document is not of that type. Check doc.DocumentType (kPartDocumentObject / kAssemblyDocumentObject) before casting, or use `doc as AssemblyDocument` and test for null.

rules.pattern: InvalidCastException: Unable to cast COM object
rules.hint: The object is a different Inventor type than assumed. Check it with `x is SketchCircle` (or the entity Type property) before casting.

rules.pattern: E_INVALIDARG|The parameter is incorrect
rules.hint: Inventor rejected an argument on the failing line: lengths are internal centimetres (mm/10), angles radians, collections 1-based, and sketch/profile inputs must belong to the same sketch/document. Check the value types on that line.

rules.pattern: E_FAIL|Unspecified error
rules.hint: Inventor could not perform the operation on the failing line (common causes: open/non-closed profile, geometry that does not intersect, a document that is not active/editable, or a modal dialog). Check the inputs on that line and inventor_health.

rules.pattern: COM target does not implement IDispatch
rules.hint: Late binding (dynamic/reflection) is not available on this object. Cast to the typed interop interface instead.
